featured_reviews.name: Jose Kizhakedathu
featured_reviews.review_text:
I came here on 27th April 2021 with my mother to have her take the second dose of Covishield vaccination due to lack of availability in our local area.

Overall the procedures are well organised as they have a token system and the timings are as per the token number alloted.

The staff are cooperative and sometimes do get overwhelmed by the people rushing but otherwise are very friendly and explain if you ask politely.

Our slot was 3-4pm and we barely waited more than 10-15 mins.

I would recommend this hospital for the vaccination facility as they are very well organised and swift. Anyone facing shortage problems in their local areas and are nearing the deadline for the second dose should definitely make the trip if you can.

All the staff members, right from the housekeeping staff, nurses, and caretakers, were extremely caring and sincere in their work.

Sister Esita, Urmila, Harshita, all were exceptionally kind to my mother and took extremely good care of her.

Neelima mausi, in particular, looked after my mother just like a family member, with remarkable affection and dedication (as shown in the attached picture).

Because of their attention and support, we all felt as if we were in the comfort of our own home.

The doctors were also highly qualified, especially Doctor Mahajan, who treated my mother with great knowledge and experience and helped her recover fully within just 4 days.

The most important aspect was the total fees, which we found quite reasonable.

If you are in the Mira Bhayandar area and looking for a good and affordable hospital, we highly recommend this hospital. 🌿🙏

featured_reviews.name: WinNie
featured_reviews.review_text:
I love gardens, and like to learn about plants. So whilst the research of uttan, a botanical garden spread over 200 acres came across. I wanted to check it and we thought a 30-60 minute time would be sufficient. We were to reach by 430pm, but by time we reached, it was 520pm. We met the guard and he explained that there is an entrance fee, which involves breakfast, lunch and a guide. This needs an entire day, or else how do you see the property which made sense. He handed me a pamphlet, which I clicked photo of and disagreed to take it. They have a number which you can book your tour on.  The guard apolgoised us, that we cannot enter the garden at 520pm but we can definitley visit the local ayurvedic shop which sells items from there itself. So we parked our vehicle in the parking and stopped at the ayurvedic shop which literally sells everything i.e. for most diseases. We spend about 30 mins there and were aghsst to also see soft drink (in plastic bottles) and chips in plastic packets, i wonder why! Most of ayurvedic items were also sold in plastic, there was not a single item in glass bottles. We did buy some items, but they sell items from across India I feel, not just from the nearby area. They also send items by post, if you wish. We had one of the most amazing ice cream cone- amul butterscotch. When they handed the items in a plastic bag, I was angry but couldn't say much to them, other than I DO NOT WANT THE BAG. I carried items in hand and places them in the car. I felt they could sell regular hand bags at a cost , people would still buy it . So when you go please don't buy plastic water bottle, and bags. Carry your own bottle and bags.
I have given the 2* rating primarily, for their disinterest towards plastic and one end they are being promoting nature and ayurvedic products.

featured_reviews.review_text: Keshav Srushti is a peaceful and inspiring place nestled in nature, perfect for a family outing or a nature walk. The lush greenery, herbal gardens, and open spaces create a refreshing escape from city life. It’s more than just a park — the campus also supports educational and social projects, including a gaushala and research on agriculture and herbal medicine, which adds depth to your visit. Visitors often enjoy feeding the cows and learning about the environment. A well-maintained and serene spot worth!

featured_reviews.name: Kruti Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text: Keshav Shruthi is a wonderful place to visit for Gau Mata. We spent around two hours there and went for the first time with friends. We really enjoyed the experience. It is a peaceful and meaningful place, and everyone should visit at least once. It is especially a great place to take children so they can learn and connect with nature and animals.

featured_reviews.review_text: A great place for residential corporate programs near Mumbai. Peaceful location with fresh air and no noise, world-class training facilities, comfortable stay, excellent food, and warm hospitality. Perfect for learning and relaxation.

featured_reviews.name: Chandrashekhar Jaiswal
featured_reviews.review_text: Rambhau Mhalgi Prabodhini (RMP), a must visit place. Discipline and national service make up this place. It should rank as one of the top best organised training facility in Maharashtra. The hospitality side is superb, the rooms are numero uno and put rooms of a five star hotel in Mumbai to a backseat. Rambhau Mhalgi Prabodhini is a nation builder academy. You can host your meetings here. I also see it as a great Tourist Destination. Please don't miss if you are in Mumbai....take a day out for RMP.... permissions may be necessary..

featured_reviews.name: AJAY CHAVAN
featured_reviews.review_text: It's supposed to be a knowledge experience centre, where many corporates hold conferences, workshops for brainstorming, while other people hold art workshops. They provide rooms for stay, which are quite economical and clean. Well maintained and the atmosphere is great. Hear birds chirping in the morning and in the evening. The food is good, almost like home cooked food. Sometimes they goof up with the breakfast menu, but over all it's a good place. Yes you may say it's back of beyond, but that's the reason the air here is clean and breathable. A nice place for a 2-3 day workshops or brainstorming sessions.
